quest.title: No Restoring This Past Land of Beauty
quest.description: Zhiping of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be investigating the earthquakes and strange monster movements in Tianqiu Valley...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, now Tianqiu Valley, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, it's you. Pleased to see you, though I certainly wasn't expecting to run into you today.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Um, anyway... have you been to Tianqiu Valley or Nantianmen lately?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: The Guild has been receiving a constant stream of reports about earthquakes in those areas recently.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: It was just minor tremors at first, but they've been getting more and more serious since.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Then, not long ago, we received word of a particularly strong earthquake that caused part of the mountains and ruins to collapse, revealing a gigantic cavern.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: The report also mentioned that some unknown monsters have been sighted in the area. Based on the descriptions, they may well be none other than the Geovishaps and Primo Geovishaps that once terrorized Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need any help from me?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Well, I'd like to ask you to head to Tianqiu Valley to investigate that huge cavern and report on the impact of the earthquake on the surrounding environment.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: As for the monsters... If it's true that they're appearing in great numbers, then we cannot afford to ignore them. We must decide on what countermeasures to take.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Of course, this counts as official work for the Guild, and you will be compensated accordingly. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll do it.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. Please stay safe while exploring in that area.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Of course, this counts as official work for the Guild, and you will be compensated accordingly. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Hmm, judging by your expression... Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, I've been there, alright...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Have you, now? Well, you are an elite adventurer, after all. It's no surprise that you follow the scent of danger wherever it leads you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the Primo Geovishaps and Tianqiu Valley...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: ...A giant cavern ruin with a Primo Geovishap within it...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Okay. I think I understand. Thank you for coming to me with this news. I'll handle the paperwork and make an official report to the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with that area, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Hmm, according to some texts, Tianqiu Valley was once a prosperous settlement at some point in the ancient past.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: As to how it came to be the way it is now, it seems to have had something to do with the rampage of an ancient dragon king...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: There aren't a lot of details available about that incident, but legend has it that Rex Lapis and his adepti eventually imprisoned it within some sort of adepti realm.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Its servants then fled into the depths of the earth and entered into a deep slumber, waiting for the day when the dragon king would rise again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does that mean that these monsters sightings...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Hahaha. Those are just folktales, you know? No one knows how true they are.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Regardless, these constant earthquakes and the sudden appearance of those monsters are matters that demand our immediate attention.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiping
dialogues.text: Right, please take this as your payment. Thank you for the information you provided.
